name: Adult Green Dragon
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 22

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If fails save, can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Two attacks: one bite + two claws OR one poison breath as bonus.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.text: Each creature within 120 ft: WIS save DC 14 or frightened 1 min.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: 90-ft × 15-ft cone: 16 (4d8) + 21 (6d6) poison. CON DC 18 = 21 (6d6) extra poison; or poisoned for 24 hr (no save).

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Cost 2)
legendaryActions.text: Flies up to half speed; each within 15 ft: 11 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning. DC 16 STR or prone.
